title: Success messages show the right text and close on their own
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Location has several eligible technicians (Clockable, Active, role not Office / not Time Clock User, enrolled here) and seeded work orders spread across statuses (Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Review/Ready for Review, Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, Imported), including at least one with no lead technician.
custom_steps:
1. Reassign a work order to a technician; read the toast.
  2. Unassign a work order; read the toast.
  3. Wait and confirm each toast dismisses itself.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After a successful reassignment you see "Lead technician updated"; after unassigning you see "Lead technician removed".
  • The success toasts dismiss themselves automatically.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S4-R5, S4-R16 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
